title: Money: real sales, no pyramid
summary: Finished pieces, custom/bulk, kits, pattern royalties, affiliate on real sales — no buy-in, no recruiting pay, no required inventory.

blocks.title: Cash from craft, not from recruiting
blocks.body: Revenue follows products and honest commissions. If a dollar only moves when someone "signs up," the model is wrong for this collective.

blocks.heading: Revenue lines
rows: Builder buys a kit or ring pack

blocks.title: Explicit anti-pyramid rules
blocks.body: No buy-in fee to join. No pay for recruiting people. No required inventory purchase. Affiliate money is commission on product sales only — never on signup volume.

items.label: Price covers labor
items.detail: Assembler rates and shop prices respect the Tier-1 time study.

items.label: Designer royalties are written
items.detail: Cut, duration, and territory in plain language.

items.label: Affiliate disclosure
items.detail: Promoters say when a link pays them.

items.label: Tax and registration
items.detail: Treat the shop like a real business — see Risks.

blocks.heading: Prove sales before you scale pay
blocks.body: Rollout phase 1 asks for stranger sales. Do not open paid assembler or affiliate spiffs until those sales exist.
